title: .respawnpack/runtime/contract.json — the machine-local interaction contract
description: Written by kernel/lib/closeout.js writeRuntime(). GITIGNORED and machine-local by design: autonomy must never travel in a clone. ⛔ IT CARRIES NO schemaVersion. That is a real gap, declared here rather than papered over: readContract() falls back to {mode:'collaborate'} for anything it cannot interpret, so an unrecognised future shape degrades to the safe mode instead of being mis-read — which is why the absence has not bitten, and is not the same as it being right.

mode.description: The closed vocabulary hooks/_runtime.js VALID_MODES enforces. Anything else is treated as absent, not as an error.

goalId.description: ⛔ LEGACY, READ-ONLY. The pre-2d spelling, still accepted by hooks/_runtime.js readContract() and closeout.js activeOf(), never written. Declared so the tolerance is auditable.

suspendedGoalId.description: `contract collaborate` SUSPENDS a goal, it does not delete one — the transition has to be cheap and reversible or nobody uses it.

acceptance.description: Delegate mode only, and never empty: a bounded task with no definition of done is an unbounded one with a shorter description.
